component.name: Dosi Tracker
component.summary: Record working time and, with your consent, activity for your team's workspace

description.p: Dosi Tracker is the Linux agent of a team time-tracking service. It is workplace monitoring software: while you track time on a project, it records your working time in blocks and uploads them, together with whatever activity details you agreed to, to the Dosi Tracker server of the workspace you signed in to. The workspace owner and admins can see that data in their dashboard.

Nothing is recorded until you sign in, choose a project and give your consent on this computer. Each kind of detail is a separate choice that you can withdraw at any time, also without a network connection:

ul.li: keyboard and mouse activity as counts per minute (never which keys or buttons);
the name and title of the active window, and which of your programs are running;
screenshots of your screen, optionally blurred.
what you type: no keystrokes, key codes, text or passwords;
the clipboard, your files or your browser history;
webcam pictures or audio (the webcam is not available on Linux in this version);
anything while tracking is paused, the screen is locked or you are signed out.

description.p: It runs as your user, never as root, and needs no input-device access. On Wayland, keyboard and mouse counts and the active window are not available and are reported as not measured, never as zero. Screenshots on Wayland go through the desktop's screenshot permission.
First release of the Linux agent.

ul.li: Background agent with a systemd user service, a tray icon and a window.
Command line with JSON output for every action.
Per-capability consent on this computer; unmeasured values are sent as not measured.
Offline queue that uploads when the server is reachable again.
Packages for Ubuntu, Debian and Fedora, and a tarball that installs without root.
